title: Trace a 2-2-1 network
description: This plain-Python forward pass computes two ReLU hidden activations and one output for three inputs.

steps.description: W1 and b1 define two hidden neurons. V and c define the output neuron, and relu keeps positive values.
forward computes each hidden pre-activation, applies ReLU, then combines the two hidden values into y.

steps.question: For input [1.0, 2.0], which hidden unit has a zero ReLU activation?
steps.answer: h2 has a pre-activation of -0.50, so ReLU returns 0.00.

steps.description: When verbose is true, the function prints each hidden calculation and the output calculation before returning y.
The loop sends three listed inputs through forward. For the first input, the trace prints hidden activations 2.00 and 0.00, then output 3.25.
